(14.22) This is the unique positive constant length and field rescaling that sets both susceptibility and second-moment length to one. Along the ordinary sequences in (14.21), the canonical cutoff fields Ψβ converge to Gs in joint law and all joint moments, and their component Schwinger measures converge strongly in S′ at every order. The analogous normalized inclined fields converge to Gs+d. The functions m, ℓ are continuous on I.
